design.name: 陌刀重甲
design.brief: The legion's heavy halberdier, a towering armoured brute: a huge broad-shouldered soldier in thick layered dark-iron and lacquer-red plate, massive pauldrons crowned with jagged ice crystals, a tall helmet with a horned crest and a full iron mask, its armour cracked open across the back where cold cyan light glows (weak spot, behind it). No shield: its armour is its defence. Big hands with a clearly separate thumb and four thick fingers; heavy armoured boots.
design.weapon: an enormous two-handed Tang mo-dao greatblade (陌刀) held across the body ready for a wide sweeping cut
design.style_note: Style target: the enemies of Gunfire Reborn — a readable military unit roster where every troop type is told apart at 30 m by silhouette and weapon. Strongly stylized, chunky and exaggerated: big helmets and pauldrons, oversized hands and weapons, compact sturdy bodies, faces hidden behind iron masks with two glowing cyan eye slits, bold saturated colour blocks (lacquer red, dark iron, bronze, white fur, cyan glow), clean bevelled forms, armour plates as a few big shapes, no tiny detail noise. Menacing and cool, not cute.
